name: Meta-pico8 (collaborative WebGL2 pixel art game maker)

mentions.name: Meta-pico8 (collaborative WebGL2 pixel art game maker)
mentions.description: A browser-based collaborative game maker for 2D WebGL2 pixel art games at 320x180 resolution (in the style of PICO-8 and games like Animal Well), designed so users can build it together. Supports arbitrary imports of user code: after creating an account and adding a JS file, other users can import it as if it were a built-in module. Includes a simple SDK, a clean API, and innovations in the GUI layer.
mentions.source_excerpt: But the short version is, I'm working on a sort of meta-pico8, a game maker for WebGL2 2d pixel art games (e.g. 320x180 games like Animal Well) that runs in the browser, but one that's firstly collaborative, so that we can all build it together.
